name: good
description: A clean vocabulary and context that should produce no findings; the baseline that guards against false positives.

name: good-hierarchy
description: A clean vocabulary with a class hierarchy (Person and Organization subClassOf Agent); no findings. Guards against the hierarchy rules false-positiving on a valid subClassOf.

name: good-coercion
description: A clean vocabulary whose object property has a node range and the matching @id coercion; no findings. Guards ctx/missing-coercion against firing on a correctly coerced property.

name: good-datatypes
description: A clean vocabulary with string, date, integer, and boolean ranges, each correctly coerced; no findings. Guards the coercion rule across datatype variety.

name: good-multiclass
description: A clean vocabulary with several independent classes and cross-class object properties, all defined and covered; no findings.

name: broken-no-definition
description: The "knows" term has neither an rdfs:label nor an rdfs:comment, so it is undefined. Expected: vocab/no-definition.

name: broken-uncovered
description: The vocabulary defines "knows" but the context does not map it, so a consumer cannot use it. Expected: pair/coverage.

name: broken-orphan
description: The context maps "ghost" into the vocabulary namespace, but no vocabulary term defines it. Expected: pair/orphan.

name: broken-collision
description: Two distinct context terms ("name" and "fullName") map to the same IRI, an ambiguous alias. Expected: ctx/iri-collision.

name: broken-unresolved
description: A context term maps to a value that is neither an absolute IRI nor a resolvable CURIE. Expected: ctx/iri-unresolved.

name: broken-unprotected
description: The context is not @protected, so a later context can silently redefine its terms. Expected: ctx/unprotected.

name: broken-unsafe-vocab
description: The top-level @vocab is not an absolute IRI, so term expansion depends on the document base. Expected: ctx/unsafe-vocab.

name: broken-hierarchy
description: A term's rdfs:subClassOf points at an in-namespace IRI that no term defines, a dangling reference. Expected: vocab/broken-hierarchy.

name: broken-deprecated-mapped
description: A term is marked owl:deprecated in the vocabulary yet is still mapped in the context. Expected: vocab/deprecated-mapped.

name: broken-missing-domain-range
description: A property declares neither rdfs:domain nor rdfs:range, so its subject/object types are unspecified. Expected: vocab/missing-domain-range.

name: broken-missing-coercion
description: A property has an xsd:date range but its context mapping omits the matching @type coercion, so values are untyped strings. Expected: ctx/missing-coercion.

name: broken-unstable-iri
description: A term IRI embeds a version segment (/v1/), tying the term identity to a version. Expected: vocab/unstable-iri.
